title: Right of injunction.
bodyText: The department may, in addition to any other remedies available, apply to a court having competent jurisdiction for an injunction to restrain any violation of this chapter.
bodyHtml: [§439A-19]  Right of injunction.  The department may, in addition to any other remedies available, apply to a court having competent jurisdiction for an injunction to restrain any violation of this chapter. [L 2022, c 73, pt of §1]
